quote: This paper presents a benchmark for evaluating the moral values of LLMs using a multi-step moral dilemma questioning protocol.
We analyze pairwise competitions between moral values by examining win rates, the proportion of times a model favors one value over another across ethical dilemmas of varying complexity.

To mitigate biases arising from single-model annotations and to enhance the reliability of value attribution, we employ a consensus-based approach using three LLMs: GPT-4o-mini, GLM-4-Plus, and DeepSeek-V3.

To evaluate the validity of the five-step dilemmas generated by GPT-4o, we conducted a human evaluation study. We randomly sampled 120 dilemmas and partitioned them into four sets, each of which was independently assessed by three NLP researchers with expertise in ethics and language modeling.
